Sonic Katar · Rare dagger

Already Rare (2500 z); rarity, price and weapon stats stay. Only Sonic Blow changes, and the item text moves to the house convention.

Sonic Katar · Dagger · Two-handed · Melee · DEX + DEX · HR + 5 Physical
  • Double Strike
  • You may perform the skill 【💥Sonic Blow】
💥 Sonic Blow · Cost 30 MP 50 MP · One creature · Instantaneous · Melee · Keywords: Chain 8 Volley

Perform an attack with this weapon against the target. It deals double damage and each of its hits has a −2 penalty to its Accuracy Check. If every hit lands, the attack deals 50% more damage. A hit that is a Critical Success deals 50% more damage but does not generate an Opportunity.

Perform 5 free attacks … −2 … crit +50%, no Opportunity (the old data really made one attack).

How the numbers work

  1. One action card, 8 hits, each rollsChain 8 Volley (the Tommy Gun engine): every hit makes its own Accuracy Check at −2 and can MISS. The attack's damage is doubled, then shared over the 8 hits, so each landed hit = 0.25 of a normal hit and a miss loses its share.
  2. PerfectAll 8 land: ×1.5 on the whole attack, so 3.0× a normal hit. Mixed results are about break-even (4/8 = 1.0×, 6/8 = 1.5×); a cold streak is weak (2/8 = 0.5×).
  3. iRO parodyRO's Sonic Blow is 8 hits in one bundle from a Katar, about a second long. Our version keeps the 8 hits and the RO sound and effect; it drops Stun (we don't have it) and makes each hit able to miss.

Balance read · Sonic Blow

The −X accuracy penalty · recommendation: −2

−2 works for a DEX d12 wielder: at the median DEF 12, Sonic Blow is 1.6× (Blanche) to 1.8× (Zarg) a basic attack's expected damage for 30 MP, and a Perfect stays rare (Blanche 0.2%, Zarg 5%) until accuracy pushes it, which is the synergy you asked for: Zarg's +3 against DEF 10 = 18% Perfect. −3 still pays on d12 (1.4–1.6×) but Perfect all but vanishes; −1 doubles Zarg's Perfect to 10%. With no penalty Sonic Blow is simply 2× a basic attack for everyone (the doubled damage). Keren (DEX d8) lands 11% per hit at −2 (1.13×): a DEX + DEX weapon doesn't suit her at any X, so the animation holder is just for looks.

Full damage chain (Physical)

The Perfect ×1.5 multiplies after weapon efficiency and affinity, like every multiplier. Physical weakness is rare in the roster, Physical resistance is not.

Open · your call

Before I build

  1. Gunblade: odd roll and critsA Critical Success is matching dice, so with no accuracy bonus (or an even one) its total is always even and a crit never fires the gun; with an odd bonus (Zarg +3) every crit fires. Imperial Gunblade had "odd roll or a crit". Recommend adding "or a Critical Success" back.
  2. Gunblade price1800 z proposed (Uncommon two-handed swords sit at 1400–2200).
  3. Gunblade transform timingAssumed Lionheart's: free, once per turn, before your action.
  4. Sonic Blow: the Perfect in the engineThe Perfect needs a "hits landed" count on the volley. I'll check on the runner whether HIT_COUNT already gives it; if not, it is a small engine add. Same check for whether High Roll is added per hit (Tommy Gun's ×0.25 handled that).

Real assets vs stand-ins

  1. Ragnarok Online, ripped from your clientThe sonicblow effect (RO effect library, already on Forge) and the sounds from data.grf: effect\assasin_sonicblow.wav (the skill), _attack_katar.wav + attack_katar.wav (swings), _hit_dagger.wav (hits). The wavs are not on Forge yet.
  2. The game's own lookValley_Battlemap001 on the 3D stage, the party battlers and HUD plate, damage numbers incl. the MISS word, hit counter, NPC HP bar, namecard and crit cut-in, RPG Maker MV hit clips, Forge sounds.
  3. Stand-insNo battler holds a katar or gunblade, so the holder's own idle art does the strikes (lean, step, afterimage). The Gunblade form badge in the plate shelf is the Lionheart badge with the Revolver icon. Damage values are examples from the sliders.

How to review

  1. Play each moveSonic Blow rolls its 8 hits with the dice sliders; use "Strike results" to force 8/8 Perfect, 6/8, 4/8, 2/8 or 0/8.
  2. Approve, ask for changes or rejectReview card under each move. Pause & comment (C) pins the exact moment; Space pauses and resumes.
  3. TuneEvery number is a slider; the balance reads update as you drag. Moved sliders travel with your feedback.
  4. Send feedbackOne button in the side panel.
